title: The first upgrade from any shipped build (19-Sep 0.8.0 / v0.8.0, no data_cache meta.build row) takes no data-dir backup: ensure_build clears the cache and the stores migrate with nothing copied to backups/
repro: cp -R seed data; sqlite3 data_cache.db 'DROP TABLE meta'; every db PRAGMA user_version=0 (the pre-ca25a5ca shape, as the 19-Sep 7969d087 and v0.8.0 data_cache.py have no meta table); at 633f8440: cd sidecar && VYSTED_DATA_DIR=<dir> ./.venv/bin/python3 -c 'import asyncio; from services import data_cache; print(asyncio.run(data_cache.ensure_build("0.9.0")))' -> 'cache written by an unversioned build - cleared', 38 rows deleted, no backups/ dir. Control with meta.build=0.7.9-prior backs up to backups/0.7.9-prior.
